d: MS Dhoni’s future at Chennai Super Kings (CSK) is back in focus, with the former CSK captain expected to make a call on IPL 2027 after assessing his fitness. Dhoni missed the entire IPL 2026 season with a calf injury, leaving CSK to navigate another difficult campaign. With five IPL titles behind him but questions mounting over the team’s direction, how long can Chennai wait for a decision? Rupha Ramani examines Dhoni’s IPL future, CSK’s succession plans and what his next move could mean for the franchise.
